$comment: [X2.1] MCP Attach Spec — TEMPLATE. Copy to `<slug>.json` (filename === `slug` === seed area `name` === `tool_prefix` === the federation namespace prefix — doctrine #5 NO COLLISION). This file is the canonical `ExternalMcpSpec` shape consumed by the X2 spec library: snapshot generator (X2.10), attach E2E (X2.11), validators (X2.8/X2.9), and the `marketplace_spec(slug)` MCP tool (X2.23). Underscore-prefixed files (`_template.json`, `_*`) are NOT real specs — every spec-dir reader skips `f.startsWith("_")`. CC0-1.0.

_doc.slug: Stable kebab-case identity. MUST equal the filename (minus .json), the `seed-areas-list.json` area `name`, the `tool_prefix`, and the federation namespace prefix. Unique across the registry (doctrine #5).
_doc.title: Human-readable area name shown in marketplace UI + `marketplace_browse` output.
_doc.publisher: Lowercase GitHub org/owner. MUST be a `knownPublishers` key in trust.json (doctrine #2 NO SILENT ATTACH) and the filename of the matching `mcp-trust-evidence/<publisher>.md`.
_doc.trust: Resolved tier — MUST match the publisher's tier in trust.json. One of: first-party-ms | verified-publisher | community | untrusted.
_doc.tool_prefix: Namespace prefix prepended to every federated tool (`<tool_prefix>.<tool>`). Equals `slug`. Unique (doctrine #5).
_doc.description: One-sentence summary of what the server does.
_doc.transport: How the kernel launches/connects to the server. `kind`=stdio-subprocess ⇒ `command`+`args` (+optional `env_passthrough`); `kind`=http-sse ⇒ `url`. `env_passthrough` lists ONLY env-var NAMES forwarded to the subprocess — NEVER literal secret values (doctrine #6 NO LEAKED CREDENTIALS).
_doc.version_pin: Upstream package + the supported semver `version_range` (X2.16). `tested_version` is the exact version the committed snapshot (X2.10) was captured against. CI warns when upstream `latest` exits `version_range`.
_doc.env_vars: Env-var matrix (X2.13). One row per variable: `name`, `required` (bool), `auth_mode` (which auth path it belongs to), `description`. Names only — no values.
_doc.auth: Auth recipe (X2.17). `recipe` is a 1-line summary surfaced in `marketplace_browse`; `modes` enumerates supported auth paths in preference order.
_doc.sample_tools: Representative tools the server exposes (X2.10). `name` is the bare upstream tool name (the snapshot prepends `tool_prefix`); `summary` is a short description. NOT exhaustive — the snapshot file holds the full tools/list.
_doc.destructive_tools: Bare names of every tool with destructive side-effects (X2.18). When the publisher's trust policy sets `allowDestructive: false`, the kernel blocks these calls (X2.19).
_doc.known_limitations: Caveats a consumer must know before attaching (X2.14) — e.g. first-run browser install, subscription-scope requirements, rate limits.
_doc.client_install: Per-client install hints (X2.15): `claude_desktop` / `cursor` / `vscode` each a short config snippet or instruction string with the federation namespace prefix.
_doc.snapshot: `path` = repo-relative location of the committed tools/list snapshot (X2.10). `drift_threshold_pct` = max allowed tools/list shape change before the nightly job (X2.12/X2.24) flags drift.
_doc.last_reviewed: ISO date of the most recent human spec review. Recorded in mcp-specs-changelog.md (X2.28).
_doc.reviewer: GitHub handle of the maintainer who authored/reviewed this spec.
